workflows.name: Clinic Missed Call - Appointment Booking & Rescheduling
workflows.greeting: Hello! This is Apex Care Medical Centre calling you back after missing your call. Are you calling to book a new appointment, reschedule, or inquire about clinic hours?

fields_schema.label: Patient Full Name
fields_schema.promptQuestion: May I please have the patient's full name?

fields_schema.label: Contact Phone Number
fields_schema.promptQuestion: What is the best phone number to confirm the appointment?

fields_schema.label: Doctor or Specialty
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Which doctor or specialty are you looking for? We have General Physicians, Cardiology, Dermatology, and Pediatrics.

fields_schema.label: Preferred Date
fields_schema.promptQuestion: What date works best for you?

fields_schema.label: Preferred Time Slot
fields_schema.promptQuestion: What time do you prefer, such as morning at 10 AM or afternoon at 4 PM?

fields_schema.label: Brief Reason for Visit
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Could you briefly share the main reason for your visit?

conditional_rules.resultNote: Potential cardiac emergency flagged. Prompt patient to seek emergency care if acute.

workflows.closing_message: Thank you! Your appointment request has been synchronized with our clinic calendar, and an SMS confirmation will be sent shortly.

workflows.name: Cake Studio Missed Call - Custom Order & Inquiry
workflows.greeting: Hi there! This is Sweet Delights Cake Studio returning your call. Are you interested in placing a custom cake order, or did you have a quick question about our menu?

fields_schema.label: Customer Name
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Can I get your name please?

fields_schema.label: Occasion or Cake Style
fields_schema.promptQuestion: What occasion is the cake for, such as Birthday, Wedding, or Anniversary?

fields_schema.label: Cake Flavor
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Which flavor would you love? Our favorites are Belgian Chocolate Truffle, Red Velvet, Vanilla Bean, and Fresh Berry.

fields_schema.label: Weight or Size
fields_schema.promptQuestion: What size or weight are you looking for, such as 1 kg, 2 kg, or a 2-tier cake?

fields_schema.label: Date Required
fields_schema.promptQuestion: For what date do you need the cake?

fields_schema.label: Custom Inscription / Piping
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Would you like any personalized name or message written on the cake?

fields_schema.label: Pickup or Delivery
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Will you pick it up at our studio or do you need delivery?

fields_schema.label: Estimated Budget
fields_schema.promptQuestion: Do you have a target budget in mind?

conditional_rules.resultNote: Order needed within 24 hours! Rush kitchen notice required.

workflows.closing_message: Wonderful! Our head baker has received all the details and will text you the digital sketch and invoice. Have a delightful day!
